hydromagnesite.definition:
n. A hydrous carbonate of magnesia occurring in white,
   early, amorphous masses.

hydroman.translation: 液压操作器, 水力控制器

hydromancer.translation: n. 用水占卜的术士, 水占术

hydromancy.definition: n divination by water (as by patterns seen in the ebb and flow of the tides)

hydromantic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to divination by water.

hydromechanics.definition:
n. That branch of physics which treats of the
   mechanics of liquids, or of their laws of equilibrium and of motion.
hydromechanics.translation:
n. 流体力学
[化] 流体力学

hydromedusa.definition:
n. Any medusa or jellyfish which is produced by budding
   from a hydroid. They are called also Craspedota, and naked-eyed
   medusae.

hydromedusae.translation: n. 水螅水母( hydromedusa的名词复数 )

hydromel.definition: n honey diluted in water; becomes mead when fermented
hydromel.translation: n. 蜂蜜酒(蜂蜜和水的混合物,经发酵后成为蜂蜜酒)

hydrometallurgical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to hydrometallurgy; involving
   the use of liquid reagents in the treatment or reduction of ores.

hydrometallurgy.definition:
n. The art or process of assaying or reducing ores by
   means of liquid reagents.

hydrometamorphism.translation: 水热变质, 水变质作用

hydrometeor.definition:
n. A meteor or atmospheric phenomenon dependent upon the
   vapor of water; -- in the pl., a general term for the whole aqueous
   phenomena of the atmosphere, as rain, snow, hail, etc.
hydrometeor.translation: n. [汽]水汽凝结体,水汽现象

hydrometeorological.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to hydrometeorology, or to
   rain, clouds, storms, etc.

hydrometeorology.definition:
n. That branch of meteorology which relates to, or
   treats of, water in the atmosphere, or its phenomena, as rain, clouds,
   snow, hail, storms, etc.

hydrometer.definition: n. a measuring instrument for determining the specific gravity of a liquid or solid
hydrometer.translation:
n. 液体比重计
[化] 液体比重计

hydrometer aerometer.translation: [机] 量气计, 气体比重计

hydrometers.definition:
plural of hydrometer
n. a measuring instrument for determining the specific gravity of a liquid or solid
hydrometers.translation:
(hydrometer 的复数) n. 液体比重计
[化] 液体比重计

hydrometric.definition: a of or relating to hydrometry
hydrometric.translation: a. 液体比重计的,液体比重测定的

hydrometrical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to an hydrometer, or to the
   determination of the specific gravity of fluids.
a. Of or pertaining to measurement of the velocity,
   discharge, etc., of running water.
a. Made by means of an hydrometer; as, hydrometric
   observations.
hydrometrical.translation: a. 比重计的, 测定比重的

hydrometry.definition: n. the measurement of specific gravity
hydrometry.translation:
n. 液体比重测定, 流水速力测定, 流量测定
[化] 液体比重测定; 液体比重测定法

hydromica.definition:
n. A variety of potash mica containing water. It is less
   elastic than ordinary muscovite.

hydromine.translation: 水力开采矿井, 水力机械化矿

hydromining.translation: 水力采矿, 水力开采法

hydromorphic.translation: [植]具有适于水生的结构特性的

hydromorphone.definition: n a narcotic analgesic (trade name Dilaudid) used to treat moderate to severe pain

hydromorphone hydrochloride.translation: [医]盐酸二氢吗啡酮：二氢吗啡酮的盐酸盐，化学式为C171H19NO3。HCl,与二氢吗啡酮有相同作用

hydromotor.translation: 射水发动机, 液压马达, 油马达

hydromyinae.definition: n. water rats of Australia and New Guinea
